newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 6.342 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 6.342 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$3 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposits on Monday at an average yield of 6.342 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 6.226 and 6.450 percent.
The central bank has said its recent series of NCD issues aimed to absorb banking system's extra money, but not to dampen stock market turnover as many analysts have asserted.
On Monday, Taiwan share prices ended up 119.62 points or 1.44 percent at 8,421.87 in a technical rebound after five straight sessions of falls, brokers said.
